My worry on WBE is that as time goes on we seem to find that more and more of consciousness is ephemeral. This talks briefly about dynamical state, but dismisses the concerns. We know, for instance, that people can become "stuck" in comas for years or decades. Even when the initial damage is repaired, things have a very hard time "rebooting", for lack of a better word. Like a computer that has had its boot sector corrupted over time, it works fine until you try to start it again. Yes, occasionally people wake up after a coma, but they often don't too.

I worry that WBE will be difficult to impossible because there is no way to capture a snapshot of the fine ephemeral structure at close enough to the same instant in time to be coherent. Potentially literally "no way", if uncertainty comes into play.
